first.rationale: Competitor pricing pressure makes promotional_pricing tempting, but memory_73 explicitly warns of a pooled-cohort confound from a mid-test redefinition, so its acquisition/revenue lift claim is unreliable for a high-stakes pricing response that could erode margins and long-term qualified revenue. Meanwhile both onboarding completion and activation are down this quarter despite memory_31 and memory_86 previously showing durable gains from onboarding simplification—this divergence suggests either regression of the earlier fix or a new causal factor, and re-verifying the original signup-simplification record (memory_31) lets me confirm the mechanism still applies before committing the week's single experiment slot. Simplify_onboarding directly targets two of the three concurrent problems (activation and onboarding completion) without the margin/long-term-value risk inherent in matching competitor pricing, and can be run as a guarded test to re-confirm the durable lift under current conditions before considering broader or pricing-based responses next cycle.
